credit: Jesse Allen, NASA Earth Observatory; GEBCO, British Oceanographic Data Centre
processing: Lossless RGBA PNG. Float32 elevation smoothed at 1/3/10 pixels on an 8K working raster; weighted geographic gradients .80/.72/.20 with strength 72 and latitude correction. R/G normal, B smoothed height, A medium-minus-broad curvature. Each float data channel is resampled independently to 4K and quantized once; curvature is never interpreted as opacity. Narrow ridges are balanced with coherent ranges; shader footprint filtering limits fine specular noise. No generated artwork, screenshots, or procedural terrain noise.
